name: Irish technical writer returning with a documentation portfolio

constraints: Writing responsibilities rather than software developer role
Career break should not reset seniority
context.company_awareness: Some former industry contacts; needs to rediscover current documentation teams.

trigger: A refreshed documentation portfolio feels ready, but searches mix developer jobs, content marketing and office-based returner programmes.

searches_run.observation: Retrieved a direct Astreya remote-Ireland posting, specialist writing company careers and general aggregators. This offers specific writing sources alongside broad boards.

searches_run.query: technical writer return career break flexible hours remote Ireland
searches_run.observation: Retrieved a Workday career-returner listing and Bárd's remote/flexible careers page. Direct Bárd inspection states flexible hours but solicits ongoing writer interest; it is not proof of a currently open matching role or returner eligibility.

sources.title: Technical writing careers | Bárd Global
sources.supports: Direct inspection documents remote-first/flexible-hours employer language and ongoing CV invitation; individual vacancy terms and returner acceptance not established.

sources.title: Technical Writer II | Astreya
sources.supports: Retrieved direct employer result names Remote Ireland; current availability and hours not verified.

sources.title: Sr Associate Technical Writer Career Returner | Workday on LinkedIn
sources.supports: Retrieved listing explicitly targets returners and combines in-person and remote work; do not treat it as fully remote or verified current intake.

best_entry_page.primary_query: technical writer remote Ireland flexible hours
best_entry_page.promise: Find covered documentation employers and distinguish remote location, flexible hours and genuine writing responsibilities using posting evidence.
best_entry_page.cta: Search technical-writing titles and follow suitable covered employers.
proof_needed: Ireland remote scope and actual core-hour evidence
No inference that returners need junior roles
Distinguish active vacancies from general talent-interest pages
Examples where portfolio work is accepted in stated requirements

conversion_objections: Remote is not the same as flexible hours.
A returnship may require office attendance.
I want appropriate experience level despite my break.
A company-wide benefits page may not apply to my role.

avoid_targeting.query: guaranteed return to work technical writer programme

avoid_targeting.reason: Portfolio authoring is not demonstrated product functionality.

message_to_founder: Simulation: My portfolio shows I can still do the work; I need help finding the right writing role, not being automatically treated as a beginner. Keep remote location and working hours separate, and show whether the opening is real or just an invitation to send a CV.

confidence_and_limits: Synthetic simulation, not an interview or an independent respondent. Two queries retrieved on 2026-09-28, with at least one direct page inspection. Queries without observed source IDs are hypotheses. Combined retrieval is not a controlled ranking report. No volume, difficulty or conversion inference. Source claims and role availability can change; product fit uses the supplied repository brief.
